def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The colored diagonal tracks are repeated periodically along c-r.
    # The 1 tracks are 23 units apart, with the 5 track 10 units after
    # the first 1 track; continue the two-color pattern between tracks.
    period = 23
    motif = [0] * period
    # Track positions modulo period: 5 at 6, 1 at 16.
    # Interpolate the bands evenly across the two intervals.
    for k in range(period):
        d = (k - 6) % period
        motif[k] = 5 if d < 10 else 1
    return [[motif[(c-r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
